FX-GLOW-001.says: Bright parts, threshold 60, radius 4: the yellow patch and the brown one, whose brightest channel is exactly 60 %, glow; the purple does not, though the light of the others reaches it. The glow spreads into the empty space round the patches, which shows it.

FX-GLOW-003.says: Radius 0: nothing spreads, and each glowing pixel is added onto itself, twice as bright.

FX-GLOW-004.says: Threshold 100: nothing is that bright, so the drawing is untouched.

FX-GLOW-005.says: Threshold 0: every pixel that shows glows, the purple too.

FX-GLOW-006.says: Threshold 61: the brown, at exactly 60 %, no longer glows.

FX-GLOW-007.says: Chosen colours, the purple chosen: only the purple glows.

FX-GLOW-008.says: The purple chosen one step off in blue, tolerance 0: nothing is chosen, and the drawing is untouched.

FX-GLOW-009.says: The same at tolerance 1: the purple is chosen again, and this is FX-GLOW-007.

FX-GLOW-010.says: Chosen colours with none chosen: the drawing, untouched.

FX-GLOW-011.says: Intensity 2.5: the glow is two and a half times as strong, and where it adds past white it is not cut off.

FX-GLOW-012.says: Operation Screen: the glow is screened on, which never passes white.

FX-GLOW-013.says: Tint #ff4000: the glow is orange, whatever the colour that lit it.

FX-GLOW-014.says: After Effects' own defaults, threshold 60, radius 10, intensity 1, Add.

FX-GLOW-015.says: The patches half covering: they glow as in FX-GLOW-001, at half the strength.

FX-GLOW-016.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-GLOW-003, frame 2 is FX-GLOW-001, frame 4 is radius 8.

FX-GLOW-017.says: Threshold keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-GLOW-001, frame 4 has the purple glowing too.

FX-GLOW-018.says: Intensity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-GLOW-001.

FX-GLOW-019.says: FX-GLOW-001 moved three pixels right: the glow is done on the drawing before it is moved, and the part of it that spread past the drawing's left edge now shows in columns 1 and 2.

FX-GLOW-020.says: Radius 2.5: a radius is not rounded, so this is neither radius 2 nor 3.

FX-GLOW-021.says: FX-GLOW-007 and FX-GLOW-013 with the colours written in capitals: the same.

FX-GLOW-022.says: Radius 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-023.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-024.says: Radius keyed to 600 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-025.says: Threshold 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-026.says: Intensity 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-027.says: Intensity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-028.says: Tolerance 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-029.says: Nine colours, one more than eight. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-030.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-031.says: A tint written "orange". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-032.says: Operation "multiply", which is not Add or Screen. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLOW-033.says: Based on "dark", which is not bright or colors. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
